# Noobot v4.4.1

This release converges identity, session, runtime, and plugin protocols onto
single sources of truth, removes fallback and alias paths across the codebase,
hardens session storage migration, and moves quality rules into one enforced
check protocol.

## Identity and protocols

- Make `messageId` the single message identity and register message fields in
  the session-protocol schema.
- Derive command, turn, and execution identity from the protocol; scope channel
  state by turn and require `dialogProcessId` in message events.
- Converge terminal status, turn phase, lifecycle envelope, reconnect replay,
  and live projection onto protocol-owned contracts.
- Converge session deletion onto `deletedSessionIds`, plugin workspace paths
  onto one source, and give memory consolidation its own turn identity.
- Upgrade the semantic transfer envelope to v3 and bind transfer identity to
  the owning runtime.

## Session storage

- Migrate sessions to schema 13 through workspace layout v9 and model context
  snapshots to v4, with per-item migration failure isolation.
- Gate legacy migration by release schema and show startup upgrade progress.
- Fail fast on lost durable journal writes, fix a lock re-entry leak, and
  harden atomic repair.
- Validate session tree nodes strictly during rebuild and storage upgrade.

## Cleanup

- Remove fallback chains, id and field aliases, snake_case reads, and dead
  exports, parameters, and forwarders.
- Consolidate shared value and type helpers (`text`, `isPlainObject`,
  `isObjectLike`) in `@noobot/shared/value`.
- Move remaining CJK literals into i18n, including `\uXXXX` escaped forms.
- Accept only `user:*` for workflow all-attachment references and only
  enumerated scenario values in dynamic policies.

## Quality

- Run all quality guards under one check protocol with stale exemption
  detection and baselines that only decrease.
- Audit main and auxiliary model requests in the Docker E2E suite.

## Fixes

- Terminate workflows on node failure and fix nodes stuck in `RUNNING`.
- Commit `FAILED` when a child terminal receipt is rejected.
- Project detached sub-session results from the committed turn.
- Bind the Electron backend recovery handler after bootstrap.
- Show the failure message in the error turn terminal notice.
